content.description: Metaps worked together with EMURGO on the world's first cryptocurrency card for the ADA cryptocurrency. The card enables users to spend their ADA at over 30,000 offline merchants in South Korea including well-known convenience stores such as Emart24. Users have the option of selecting a mobile gift card or a physical gift card that works easily with mobile app recharge capabilities.
